notes: Core package maps to wo-slide::model::Presentation{slides,masters,theme,slide_size} and wo-ooxml PptxPresentation; presentation.xml extras (props, embeddedFontLst, custShowLst, sectionLst, photoAlbum, kinsoku) are dropped.
SlideSize{cx,cy EMU} round-trips via serializer build_presentation_xml; standard()/widescreen() presets in wo-slide model.rs; x2t maps to a slide_size name.
Notes page size unmodeled; there is no notes render path to consume it.
CJK line-break rule table dropped; wo text layout has no hook that could honor it yet.
photoAlbum part (bulk image insertion settings) unmodeled.
Slide sections (grouping + zoom targets) absent; deck outline cannot group slides.
Custom shows (subset slide runs) unmodeled; ShowPr customShowId link also absent.
Embedded fonts not extracted or registered; bytes only survive via wo-x2t PptxExtraPart pass-through.
p:sld -> wo-slide::model::Slide and wo-ooxml Slide{id,name,layout_id,master_id,shapes,notes,transition,animations,timing_raw,background}.
Common slide data: spTree + bg mapped; clrMapOvr group and slide-level text defaults not carried.
Color-map override unread anywhere; inheritance.rs therefore resolves theme colors without override maps (approximation).
SlideTransition{effect: TransitionEffect (39 kinds), duration, advance_mode, advance_timing}; parser maps 36 element names; per-effect params (dir/orient/spokes) and sound are dropped.
Preserved verbatim as Slide.timing_raw XML string (parser.rs parse_pptx_timing_raw) for round-trip; no typed DAG — see Logic/Timing rows.
wo-slide SlideLayout{id,name,layout_type,shapes,placeholder_types}; layout lookup by id/name in inheritance.rs get_layout().
wo-slide SlideMaster{id,name,slide_layouts}; master resolution in inheritance.rs get_master() with slide.master_id -> layout's master fallback.
Master title/body/other text style lists unmodeled; text on master-styled decks falls back to DocxParagraph defaults.
Header/footer visibility flags (dt/ftr/sldNum) unmodeled on slides, layouts and masters.
Notes captured as Slide.notes plain string (parse_pptx_notes); notes shapes, notes-master inheritance and notes background lost; part bytes kept by x2t extra-parts.
Notes master part unmodeled; notes text cannot inherit styling.
Handout master unmodeled; handout print layout absent.
Modern threaded comments unmodeled; bytes pass through wo-x2t PptxExtraPart only.
Reply chains absent on the Rust side.
Moniker addressing (part+shape+text-range pointers) has no Rust counterpart; also needed by animation targets and review.
Author identities (name/initials/id) lost on the model path.
tableStyles.xml unmodeled; WO TableShape cells carry explicit fill_color only.
Presentation-wide defaults (rtl, firstSlideNum, htmlPublishPr) dropped.
Slideshow settings: present/browse/kiosk mode, sldAll/sldRg ranges, penClr — absent.
Print defaults (what/how to print slides, handouts, notes) absent; WO print path renders slides only.
Normal/Sorter/Outline/Notes/Slide view state (scale, origin, guides, restored panes) unmodeled; WO keeps no persisted slide view state.
wo-slide Theme{ColorScheme, FontScheme} covers clr+font; FmtScheme (fill/ln/effect style tables), clrMap and extraClrSchemeLst absent — shape styleRef lookup is therefore impossible.
ColorScheme with ThemeColor entries in wo-slide model.rs.
Major/minor latin fonts carried as ThemeFont; per-script supplemental font list (FontCollection/SupplementalFont) absent.
Theme fill/line/effect style tables — the basis of every styleRef idx lookup — absent; themed shapes must be flattened to explicit fills.
clrScheme+fontScheme mapped; fmtScheme slot missing (see row above).
Extra color schemes and theme color maps dropped (byte pass-through only).
Visio-theme compatibility layer; no WO counterpart planned for slides.
parse_pptx_shapes iterates DIRECT children of p:spTree only (sp/pic/tbl/cxnSp); nested p:grpSp groups and their shapes are silently dropped on parse.
4 of ~8 element families parsed; graphicFrame(chart/ole), grpSp, contentPart unhandled.
Group transform / child-offset scaling unmodeled; grouped decks lose grouped shapes entirely.
Bounds{x,y,cx,cy} EMU + rotation; x2t WoShapeData carries x/y/width/height/rotation/zIndex.
xfrm/prstGeom/fill/line subset carried; scene3d/sp3d/effectDag and style refs dropped.
p:sp -> AutoShape{preset_type} or PlaceholderShape; custGeom and styleRef unpopulated (see those rows).
wo-slide geometry.rs PresetShapeType catalog (~187 presets, categories, adjust counts, guide formulas) — the port of CPPTShape's preset table.
geometry.rs Path/GuideFormula/PathCommand model the custGeom DSL, but wo-ooxml's parser never populates it from XML — custom geometry degrades to a rect.
ConnectorShape + ConnectorShapeType (straightConnector1, bentConnector2-5, curvedConnector2-4) with start/end arrowheads.
PictureShape{image_data,image_extension}; x2t WoImageData wraps a data: URL.
Ids preserved; crop-preference flags (preferTrueSize etc.) dropped.
Embedded image bytes round-trip; srcRect crop and tile/stretch fill modes lost.
Media parts byte-preserved via PptxExtraPart; blip color effects (alphaModFix, duotone) dropped.
Table frames parsed into TableShape; chart frames skipped at parse even though wo-slide ChartRef and x2t WoShapeData.chart exist as target models; oleObject absent.
Slide run hyperlinks not parsed (hyperlink_rid handling is DOCX-only in wo-ooxml parser.rs).
ActiveX / form controls dropped.
Ids/names preserved; inheritance.rs shape_id() and WoShapeData.id key on them.
placeholder_type string mapped; idx-based matching of multiple same-type placeholders not honored — inheritance.rs only matches inherited shapes by id.
TextBody{paragraphs: Vec<DocxParagraph>} reused from the word model for text boxes, auto shapes, placeholders and table cells.
Anchor/insets/wrap/autofit unmodeled — slide text layout cannot reproduce normAutofit fontScale shrink or vertical anchoring.
DocxParagraph (alignment/spacing/indent/level) reused; pPr defRPr inheritance chain from layout/master absent.
DocxRun (bold/italic/underline/size/color/font) reused; slide-specific run attrs (kern, caps, spc) partial.
latin/ea/cs font splits collapsed to one font; highlight and run-direction flags partial.
Text fields (slidenum, datetime, footer) dropped — dynamic slide numbering impossible.
Soft line breaks inside slide text bodies not preserved.
OMML math in slides unsupported (same gap as the word side).
No buChar/buAutoNum read anywhere in the pptx text path (verified: 0 matches for buChar|buAutoNum in wo-ooxml parser.rs); parsed deck bullets collapse to plain paragraphs.
Per-part default list styles absent.
Paragraph default-properties chain (defRPr / lvl overrides) absent.
Tab stops in slide text dropped.
spcPct/spcPts ride DocxParagraph spacing where present.
normAutofit/spAutoFit/noAutofit modeling absent — text overflow rendering diverges on dense decks.
Fill enum = Solid|Gradient only; noFill is expressed as None Option; pattFill/blipFill/grpFill variants absent.
Fill::Solid(hex).
GradientFill{kind Linear/Radial, stops, angle} with GradientStop{position,color}.
Pattern fills lost — common on template master backgrounds.
Group-inherited fills absent (groups themselves are dropped).
Picture fill modes absent.
Colors carried as plain hex strings; the color-context pipeline (per-color modifiers) absent.
Direct hex colors preserved everywhere.
ThemeColor/ColorScheme exist in the model, but nothing resolves schemeClr references through the theme: inheritance.rs returns background None and shape fills are stored explicit.
System/preset/style-referenced colors unsupported.
alpha/tint/shade/lumMod/lumOff transforms absent — themed color variants render at base color.
EffectList{shadow,glow,reflection} is a fixed 3-slot struct, not a composable effect list.
ShadowEffect{dx,dy,blur_radius,color,opacity}.
GlowEffect{radius,color,opacity}.
ReflectionEffect + ReflectionDirection.
ShadowEffect has no inner/outer discriminator — inner shadows render as outer.
Shape blur/soft-edge absent.
Raster color-effect pipeline absent; wo-raster has no such operations yet.
3-D scene stack absent — 3-D styled shapes flatten to flat fills.
OO's class-per-effect hierarchy collapses into one TransitionEffect enum (39 kinds) + SlideTransition params; serialize path re-emits element names.
dir (u/d/l/r) attributes dropped — push/wipe/cover/uncover always animate the default direction.
orient (horz/vert) attribute dropped.
In/out direction attribute dropped.
spokes attribute dropped.
Transition sounds dropped; WoSlide.transition_sound_enabled exists in the x2t JSON bridge but carries no media and is not wired to the wo-slide SlideTransition.
showBlackOnEnd flag dropped.
Typed time-node DAG unmodeled; only the timing_raw XML string survives round-trip.
animation.rs TimelineBuilder re-models the main sequence with onClick/withPrevious/afterPrevious triggers (AnimationTrigger) and a player.
Parallel time nodes unmodeled — simultaneous effects serialize sequentially.
Nested timelines unmodeled; AnimationData is a flat per-slide list.
TimelineEntry computes concrete start/end times and progress (is_active_at/compute_progress).
Interactive triggers (start on click of specific shape, on media end) reduced to 3 start modes.
Property-set animations (visibility/style flip) absent.
Flattened into AnimationData.effect name strings; per-frame parameter animation absent (animation.rs phases approximate).
AnimationData.target carries the shape id; text-range (TxEl) and diagram targets lost.
Build steps (progressive paragraph/diagram/chart reveal) absent.
Iterated/tamplated/exclusive timing nodes absent.
Media time nodes absent; media shapes themselves unsupported (see Media row).
TableShape{columns,rows} parsed from graphicFrame/graphic > tbl.
TableColumn.width / TableRow.height EMU.
text_body + row_span/col_span + fill_color; margins, vertical anchor and borders absent.
Cell marL/marR/anchor/vert/fill structure unmodeled.
Cell borders dropped — tables render without rules (the most common visual complaint for parsed decks).
firstRow/bandRow/bandCol flags and tableStyleId dropped.
The whole tableStyles.xml styling pipeline (style id -> band/first-row/part styles) is absent.
Audio/video shapes unsupported; bytes pass through PptxExtraPart but nothing renders or plays them.
SmartArtShape{diagram_type,data_layout} labels only; dgm data/layout/colors parts unmodeled — SmartArt renders as a labeled stub, not the diagram.
geometry.rs PathCommand + Path model the path DSL; XML wiring pending (same gap as CustGeom).
Localized heading-text variants for outline/app.xml exports absent.

OO's flowchart/vector -> DrawingML conversion pipeline (SpTreeElem + CXmlWriter + CImageManager) has no Rust counterpart; belongs in a new wo-drawing crate (or wo-slide::drawing) reusing geometry.rs/ops.rs.
The preset shape catalog is ported as geometry.rs PresetShapeType incl. adjust guides; converter-specific per-shape render code is not needed by WO.
Drawing -> DOCX embed path absent (no flowchart-to-word insertion in WO).
Legacy binary .ppt (OO .bin) reader absent — hard gap for .ppt import; x2t-class work.
WO keeps images byte-exact via PptxExtraPart; no dedup/resize/format conversion, so heavily-reused media is stored redundantly.
HTML/CSS drawing export surface absent in WO.
Font substitution/availability probing for conversions absent (wo-fonts covers render-side only).
Package open/parse/write ~= router.rs pptx<->wo-presentation pair + wo-ooxml parse_pptx/serialize_pptx + PptxExtraPart re-zip; legacy .ppt bridge and EditorBin export missing.
Infra classes intentionally not ported 1:1 — the zip crate plus String/XML template builders in wo-ooxml serializer.rs (build_pptx_content_types, build_pptx_*_rels) cover the same duties.
ZIP container traversal replaced by the zip crate in wo-x2t converters.rs; no 1:1 class needed.
Part dispatch replaced by router.rs format registration + content-type sniffing.
Template-based serialization in wo-ooxml serializer.rs replaces the writer-element framework.
Hardcoded xmlns in serializer templates; roxmltree namespace checks (P_NS/A_NS) in the parser.
docProps/app.xml (slide-title list, heading pairs) not regenerated on export; docProps/core.xml is covered by wo-ooxml CoreProperties.
Deck open/edit/save cycle = PptxToWoPresentationConverter + WoPresentationToPptxConverter (router.rs pair, incl. odp round-trip).
Legacy diagram text recovery absent.
Value-limit tables play out as plain enums per feature (AnimationTrigger, ConnectorShapeType, ...); bodyPr TextWrap specifically is unmodeled (see BodyPr row).
